quest.title: Travels Are Fuller With Friends
quest.description: While at the Easybreeze Holiday Resort, you bump into someone who is telling stories...

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: #Hello there, {NICKNAME}! Do you have a moment? I've got a story I want to share...

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: It's about traveling, friends, and family.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: In the People of the Springs, there was once a famous traveler by the name of Akamai.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Together with his Koholasaurus companion, Kau Kau, he embarked on a long journey. Their quest: To traverse all of Natlan and feast on all its delicacies.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Whenever they arrived somewhere new, Akamai and Kau Kau would search for the most beautiful stone around to keep as a memento.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Their culinary journey brought them to countless places, filled their backpacks with innumerable beautiful stones, and stuffed their bellies with myriad delectable dishes.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: Legend has it that by the time they made it back to the People of the Springs, Akamai was as portly as yours truly.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: But that's all by the by. The crux of this preamble is that the duo encountered many wonderful tales on their travels.

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, if your ears are ready to listen, I'd be more than happy to share all these happenings with you!

dialogues.speaker: Huilu
dialogues.text: I assure you, you won't regret taking the time to stop and listen!
